questions.q: Who were Daniel's three companions from Judah?
What did Daniel ask to be given instead of the king's meat?
What did Nebuchadnezzar see in his dream in chapter 2?
What smote the image upon its feet?
questions.a: A stone cut out without hands

questions.q: What did the stone become?
questions.a: A great mountain filling the whole earth

questions.q: Into what were Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego cast?
The three to the king — complete it.
questions.text: our God whom we serve is able to [deliver] us from the burning fiery [furnace],

questions.q: How many men did the king see walking loose in the fire?
What befell Nebuchadnezzar when his heart was lifted up?
questions.a: He was driven from men and did eat grass as oxen

questions.q: What words were written on the wall at Belshazzar's feast?
What did TEKEL mean?
questions.a: Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting

questions.q: Why was Daniel cast into the den of lions?
questions.a: He kept praying to his God against the decree

questions.q: How often did Daniel pray with his windows open toward Jerusalem?
How was Daniel kept safe among the lions?
questions.a: God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths

questions.q: Which king had Daniel cast into the den of lions?
Who came with the clouds of heaven to the Ancient of days?
questions.a: One like the Son of man
acc: one like the son of man
questions.x: Jesus takes this title for himself before the high priest (Mark 14:62).

questions.q: How many great beasts came up from the sea in Daniel 7?
Which angel came to Daniel to give him understanding?
What shall they that be wise do, says Daniel 12?
questions.a: Shine as the brightness of the firmament

questions.q: Put these in the order Daniel tells them.
items: The dream of the great image
